name: Balak
bio:
Balak was the son of Zippor and king of Moab. Seeing that Israel had defeated the Amorites, he was terrified, and sent messengers to summon the prophet Balaam, offering him a rich reward to curse Israel in hope of driving them out (Numbers 22:2-6).

Balaam refused at first, but Balak kept sending more distinguished officials with greater honors, until Balaam finally set out. Yet each time Balaam offered sacrifices on the altars Balak had built, intending to curse Israel, the LORD repeatedly turned his words into blessing instead of cursing. Balak grew furious and rebuked Balaam, saying, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them these three times" (Numbers 23-24). Balak ultimately failed to overcome Israel through sorcery — a story that shows how any attempt to curse a people God has blessed is ultimately futile.
